name: The Moss weekender
summary: A 38-litre weekend bag in waxed cotton, with brass hardware and a leather base. Cabin size on most airlines, and built to be repaired rather than replaced.
highlights: Waxed cotton that darkens as it is used
Solid brass buckles, cast in Birmingham
Lifetime repairs, including the ones you caused

care.title: How do I clean it?
care.description: Brush off dry mud and wipe it with a damp cloth. Never wash it: the wax comes out with the dirt.

care.title: When does it need waxing again?
care.description: About once a year, or when water stops beading on it. A tin of wax comes with the bag.

care.title: What if something breaks?
care.description: Send it back, postage paid. We fix it for free for as long as we are here.
